title: A Giant Squid's Eye Is Bigger Than a Dinner Plate

scenes.text: A giant squid's eye is the size of a basketball.
One measured 27 centimetres across, bigger than a dinner plate.
That is among the biggest eyes of any living animal.
Only extinct ocean reptiles called ichthyosaurs are known to have had bigger eyes.
The squid lives in the dark deep, hunted by sperm whales.
Imagine that eye looking back at you.
